pairs.subject: cv-presentation-and-parseability
pairs.evidence: app/landing/spark/market/data.ts:2 This module only reads and formats the Czech labour-market snapshot and the region map geometry for the landing page. It renders no CV and has no CV template, export or parse path. Searching app/landing/spark/market/ for curriculum, résumé, resume, docx and photo found nothing.

pairs.subject: cv-presentation-and-parseability
pairs.evidence: app/features/shared/renderTemplate.ts:5 The engine fills {{placeholder}} tokens and localized headings in job-description markdown templates (title, company, salary, responsibilities). It is not a CV layout engine, so none of the CV reading-order, page-budget, personal-data or export rules apply. Searching app/features/shared/ for curriculum, résumé, resume, docx and photo found nothing.
